title: [ QUAINT ] Shaders
description: Shaderpack that adds a cozy, grotesque feel to the game!
body:
Quaint Shaders

![GitHub Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/Snxhit/Quaint-Shaders?style=plastic) ![GitHub Forks](https://img.shields.io/github/forks/Snxhit/Quaint-Shaders?style=plastic) ![GitHub Issues](https://img.shields.io/github/issues/Snxhit/Quaint-Shaders?style=plastic)
--- ## Overview **Project Highlights**: - Gives the game a grotesque but cozy feel. - Revamps the classic Minecraft look. - Adds shadows, tonemapping, edge highlighting, and a lot more. --- ## Features - Grotesque yet cozy Minecraft visuals with a stylized, vibrant art direction - Soft shadow rendering for smoother, more atmospheric lighting - Time-of-day aware sunlight that changes throughout the day - Rain-tinted lighting for a moodier look during storms - Animated water waves with time-based motion - Multi-pass post-processing pipeline - Several screen-space effects: - Shadows - Bloom - Fog - ACES Tonemapping - Edge detection (Grid & Contour) - Chromatic aberration - FXAA (Fast Approximate Anti-Aliasing) - SSAO (Screen Space Ambient Occlusion) - Each with their own threshold settings! - Shader internals customized for each dimension - Advanced lighting settings --- ## Usage **Requires Iris! Supports Windows, MacOS & Linux!** - **Install from Modrinth** Find the Quaint Shaders Modrinth page [here](https://modrinth.com/shader/quaint-shaders)! Put the downloaded `.zip` file into your `/shaderpacks` folder. --- ## Screenshots - **Axolotl in a cozy, noon-lit Lush Cave!** ![Axolotl](https://res.cloudinary.com/dp7g5aflo/image/upload/v1782323926/quaint-gallery-1_hjvip7.png) - **Entrance of a deep cave, featuring Pitcher Plant!** ![Pitcher](https://res.cloudinary.com/dp7g5aflo/image/upload/v1782323935/quaint-gallery-2_vn3pvq.png) --- ### Personal Honestly, Minecraft has always been a close part of me. Going from being just a player to learning how to develop a shader has been a fun and unique experience! So if you like it, please let me know :) --- ## About Me **Snxhit**
I'm passionate about graphics programming, and mathematical concepts.
Quaint is my very first major GLSL & Minecraft project! - GitHub: [@Snxhit](https://github.com/Snxhit) - Email: [developer@snxhit.me](mailto:developer@snxhit.me) ---
